J01.note: The success modal leads with the outcome, then the minted card (artwork, The Memes #547, full title), quantity and recipient, with a single Done exit; the collector can tell what happened at a glance.

J02.note: Sequence is status, object, receipt details, primary exit, secondary explorer link; grouping is separated by one divider and matches how a receipt is read.

J03.note: Heading, card title and Done dominate correctly; the recipient address is set in bold full-white mono and carries as much weight as the card title, pulling attention slightly from the artwork and title.

J04.note: Native dark modal: iron surfaces, rounded-xl frame, rounded-lg button, success-green heading, artwork thumbnail at correct aspect; established SEIZED brand language with no confetti, neon or hype.

J05.note: Compact and task-appropriate: receipt rows sit together under one divider with no filler or empty space inside the modal.

J06.note: Consistent label/value roles, clean title wrapping and correct mono for the address; the unbroken 42-character bold mono address is the heaviest small text block and reads dense next to the lighter labels.

J07.note: Plain, specific copy: 'Your mint is confirmed.', 'Quantity', 'Minted to', 'Done', 'View transaction'; the brand heading 'SEIZED!' is immediately explained by the subtitle.

J09.note: The only pinned state, success, is deliberate: it names the object, amount and destination and offers a clear exit plus a secondary place to check the transaction.

J10.note: At 390 the modal keeps a 16px gutter, the card title wraps to three clean lines, the address fits on one line, and Done is a full-width touch target; no overflow or clipping.

J13.note: Receipt states what arrived, how many and where, with the explorer link secondary; the recipient appears only as a raw address and the modal gives no pointer to where the card can be seen in 6529, so a newcomer relies on the explorer. The submitted-to-confirmed transition is not in evidence (see S3).

findings.observation: After 'Done' and 'View transaction' (explorer), the receipt offers no in-app place to see the minted card; the recipient is a bare address without a 'your wallet' or profile cue.
findings.consequence: A collector new to wallets may not recognize the address as their own or know where the card now appears, and has to leave for the block explorer to confirm ownership.
findings.change: Optional: add a secondary link to the card or the collector's collection (for example 'View The Memes #547'), and/or a muted 'Your wallet' cue beside the recipient when it is the connected wallet.
findings.acceptance_check: The success modal offers an in-app destination for the minted card that is visually secondary to Done, and the recipient row identifies the connected wallet when applicable, at 1440x900 and 390x844.

preserve: Outcome heading with the explanatory subtitle 'Your mint is confirmed.'
Artwork thumbnail at correct aspect ratio with collection and token number above the full card title
Receipt rows for quantity and recipient, with the address in mono
Single primary 'Done' action with the explorer link ('View transaction' plus external icon) kept secondary
No confetti, countdowns, upsell or urgency on the success state
Mobile modal with 16px gutter, clean title wrapping and full-width Done
